fieldValues.title: AI agent in Evidence-backed writing
fieldValues.summary: An agent that responds to one writer's text from a stance, by linking it to claims, problems and quotes, without ever writing it.
goals: Respond to the writer's text without writing any of it
Make its stance (red team or blue team) clear in every response
Stay within what the writer asked it to look at
jobs: Link a claim to the problems, claims and quotes that bear on it
Challenge a claim as the red team
Find evidence that backs a claim as the blue team
Give a response the writer can read, accept or ignore
Pick up the writer's current focus without being re-briefed
fieldValues.needs: A declared stance and role, the writer's current focus, provenance for every link it makes, and write tools that stop it editing the writer's text.
